summary.name: Agremo
summary.one_liner: Agremo is a precision agriculture platform that turns drone and satellite imagery into crop health maps, stand counts, and agronomy recommendations.
keywords: how to count plants from drone images
use_cases: Monitoring crop health from drone or satellite images
Counting plants and checking germination after sowing
Generating variable rate herbicide and fertilizer maps
Assessing crop damage for insurance claims
Running breeding and hybrid field trials
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AI analysis of drone and satellite imagery for field crops, including crop health monitoring, weed detection, stand counts, and nutrient management. It offers RGB and multispectral orthomosaic maps, with tools to define field boundaries, mark obstacles, and measure distances and areas. Variable rate application maps are generated to reduce herbicide and fertilizer use, and weekly health reports and alerts are produced from satellite imagery. The page also mentions a DJI integration, with recipe maps for DJI AGRAS spraying drones, and features for field trials such as 14 traits, CSV export, and ground control points.
notable: Variable rate application and recipe maps for DJI AGRAS spraying drones
Plant counting with point algorithm, population heat map, and SHP export
Field trial analysis with 14 traits and CSV export
Free demo with no credit card required
caveats: Several features are labeled FREE TRIAL, so ongoing access beyond the trial is not described on the page
Pricing tiers and paid plans are not stated on the page
